title: Defensive Boosting for Online Probabilistic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.13554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study online probabilistic forecasting of binary outcomes chosen by an adaptive adversary. Given an online learning algorithm for a weak hypothesis class $H$, we would like to efficiently obtain two incomparable guarantees that existing online boosting techniques provide separately. Online gradient boosting competes in Brier score with the best predictor induced by the span of $H$ on every sequence, but promises nothing when the span does not contain an accurate predictor. Online weak-to-strong boosting drives classification error to zero under a weak-learning condition, but promises little when that condition fails.   We give a simple defensive forecasting algorithm, the Defensive Booster, that obtains both guarantees. translated_title: 防御性提升用于在线概率预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13554v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：我们研究了由自适应对手选择的二元结果的在线概率预测。给定一个针对弱假设类 $H$ 的在线学习算法，我们希望高效地获得两种不可比较的保证，这些保证是现有在线提升技术分别提供的。在线梯度提升在每条序列上与 $H$ 的跨度诱导的最佳预测器在Brier分数上竞争，但当跨度不包含准确预测器时则不提供任何保证。在线弱到强提升在弱学习条件下将分类误差驱动到零，但当该条件不满足时则承诺甚少。我们提出了一种简单的防御性预测算法——防御性提升器，它能同时获得这两种保证。在每条自适应序列上，其Brier分数与 $H$ 的跨度诱导的最佳预测竞争，速率与在线梯度提升相同；同时，每当实现的转录满足弱学习条件时，分类误差也会被驱动到零。
tldr: 本文提出一种防御性提升算法，能同时实现在线梯度提升的Brier分数竞争性和弱到强提升的分类误差收敛性，无需额外条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a defensive boosting algorithm that simultaneously achieves Brier score competitiveness of online gradient boosting and classification error convergence of weak-to-strong boosting without additional conditions.
